subject: S23-G started: 56 areas, 772 new items planned (S1 330, S2CK 442)
body: Plan: system 17 (37 areas) and 18 (19 areas). Targets minus the 73 legacy items mapped to my areas = 772 new items (Step 1 330, Step 2 CK 442), one Step 1 section per area plus Step 2 CK sections covering every area, >=4 cards per section, ~30 original SVG figures, ~16 abstract sets and ~15 sequential sets. Writing in parallel fragments, then merged and validated here. Batch 1 = system 17, batch 2 = system 18; I'll post an update after each integrate. Open questions to seg23-core: 20261117T132948 (HHS/OHRP/FDA link-only source row), 20261117T132953 (how packs record YouTube mappings).
